devices.note: Per-device status matrix for mainline ports, newest evidence wins. Each row: title = subsystem; general = status (works / partial / not yet / not started) and what that means; instance = the evidence and its versions; date = the latest evidence. F(x)tec Pro1-X (qx1050, SM6115 / Snapdragon 662) as of 2026-10-27: own kernel 7.3.0-qx1050 (v7.3 plus 16 device commits), SailfishOS 5.2.0.22 (upgraded in place from 5.1.0.11 on 2026-10-27), oFono 2.12.0+git4 with patches 0019 and 0020, PulseAudio 17.0+git2, Mesa 25.1.8, libcamera 0.7.2-4 with AF patches; reference OS NixOS (nyymi609/fxtec-pro1x-nixos, Linux 7.1) on the same unit. 'works' means confirmed by use on the device, not by a multi-day reliability test; no suspend or long-uptime measurements exist yet.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Upstream kernel support for the board
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: SoC and board DTS upstream; keyboard, audio, camera, Bluetooth, battery and vibration are carried as out-of-tree patches.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Upstream sm6115-fxtec-pro1x.dts by Dang Huynh: base v6.5, display/GPU/touch/Wi-Fi/USB/Type-C/SD/modem nodes v6.12, latest change 2026-05-19. postmarketOS (renamed Nura on 2026-09-27) has device-fxtec-qx1050 in testing on kernel 6.10. The port's series is triaged in upstreaming.json.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: SailfishOS/devices.json fxtec_mainline_2026.pro1x_qx1050, nura_rename; Pro1-X port repo port/kernel/HANDOVER.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Boot
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: U-Boot extlinux, one-shot dual boot from the NixOS partition with fallback to NixOS on any crash; not yet standalone.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Kernel, DTB, initramfs and firmware still live on or come from the NixOS partition; see boot.json.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Display and backlight
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: panel, brightness with a proper dark minimum; harmless backlight EINVAL after blanking causes a fade jump.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: BOE BF060Y8M-AJ0 at 60 Hz (pixel clock patch); 'Failed to write display brightness: -22' once in hours on 7.3; mce dim fade jumps to full once per power-key press.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-26 20:40; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/upstream.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: GPU
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: hardware GLES 3.2 under Mesa freedreno; throughput below the hybris vendor stack.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Adreno 610 (FD610), Mesa 25.1.8, lipstick on eglfs_kms; Benchymark 2.2.0 against hybris on 7.1: memory 0.59, GPU stages 0.15-0.82, CPU about equal; ran again on 5.2 (2026-10-27). UI 20-30 fps with stutter on transitions and lists.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-23, 2026-10-27; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/sfos-5.2-upgrade.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Touch
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: multitouch and double-tap-to-wake.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Goodix (module, config blob from the firmware loader); double-tap-to-wake reliable on 7.1; probed on 7.3.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Keyboard and slide switch
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: all keys, slide open/close blanking, keyboard backlight; relies on SailfishOS-only DT changes (Fn as RIGHTALT, inverted slide switch).
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: pro1x-keyboard driver; xkb symbols fxtec_vndr/pro1x (German QWERTZ, Fn legends on level 3); slide switch tlmm 96 inverted for mce; keyboard LED tlmm 103 active-low; an on-device check of every Fn legend was not recorded.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-23, 2026-10-26 20:40; Pro1-X port repo port/README.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Notification LED
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not yet: the multicolour LED exists but mce does not drive it.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: rgb:status not driven, 2026-10-23; no later evidence.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Haptics
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: UI feedback through ngfd and libngf-qt5-qtfeedback.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: AW86224 with d2s_gain=7 drv2_lvl=100; 12-effect ffmemless list.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Wi-Fi
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: connman with saved networks across boots.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: ath10k WCN3990 (needs the modem chain), stable MAC from machine-id set before connman starts.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Bluetooth
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: works when enabled from boot (pairing, A2DP); dead after a power-down until reboot.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: WCN3950 on hci_uart_qca: 0xfc00 tx timeout after power-down, regulator refcount warning (kernel item); the SailfishOS toggle blinked forever on 7.1.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-23 21:01, 2026-10-26 20:40; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/upstream.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Modem registration and SIM
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: registers on LTE at boot and the SIM is present in the stack; Settings shows it only on the Mobile network page, no 'SIM cards' page (single slot registered).
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: UIM provisioning activated every boot by qx1050-modem-prep; oFono slot driver patch 0019 exposes one slot.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Mobile data
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: IPv4 data over rmnet, Settings toggle switches it on and off.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: SailfishOS 5.2.0.22 with oFono patch 0020 (DPM open port, QMAPv4, bind without client-type): ping 3/3 about 40 ms, HTTPS 200 over rmnet_data2 on a clean boot.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Voice calls
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: calls connect in both directions; no call audio yet.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Signalling through oFono since 2026-10-26; q6voice helper qx1050-voicecall 0.1-4 starts the DSP voice session on hw:0,5, keep-alives classified into the call group, but no audio either way (see audio.json).
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: moWerk call test 2026-10-26; Pro1-X port repo port/packages/qx1050-voicecall/README.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: SMS
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: receive works; sending was not recorded as tested.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: oFono 2.12 with the slot driver, 2026-10-26.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Audio playback and microphone
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: speaker and built-in microphone from cold boot, with a boot-time card re-creation workaround for a silent first probe; the earpiece route switches but playback through it was not separately verified.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: qx1050-audio-reprobe.service (prime one stream, then re-register snd_soc_sm8250); kernel root cause open; pops at boot and USB plug remain.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Bluetooth audio
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: A2DP music playback.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Paired and played on 7.3.0-qx1050 with SailfishOS 5.1.0.11.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Call audio
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not yet.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: See Voice calls; PulseAudio profile switch to 'Voice Call (Earpiece, Mic)' works.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Headset jack detection
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not started: no MBHC in the DT, so no jack input device; headphones are a manual port switch.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Headset detection untested; the jack itself was listed as probed on 7.3.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: Pro1-X port repo port/notes/research/research-audio.md; port log 2026-10-26 20:40

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Rear camera
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: photos and video in jolla-camera with autofocus; viewfinder 10-20 fps on the GPU software ISP.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: IMX582 + DW9800 VCM, libcamera 0.7.2-4 (soft-ISP AF RFC plus own sharpness statistic and tuned scan), GPU debayer since SailfishOS 5.2 (cam 32 fps at 1280x960, 20 fps at 2000x1500); softened VCM ramps reduce the start click; 1984-wide 1080p mode.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-25 17:01, 2026-10-26 21:17, 2026-10-27; Pro1-X port repo port/notes/sfos-5.2-upgrade.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Front camera
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: fixed focus, upright and mirrored viewfinder; 1080p video slow because the binned mode is too small.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: S5K4H7; on the CPU software ISP front video recorded about 7 fps (2026-10-25); not remeasured on the GPU ISP. Intermittent I2C probe timeout seen on 7.1, not on the first 7.3 boot.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Video recording and hardware codec
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: H.264 1080p30 through Venus plus AAC in MP4.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Venus gen1 driver via qcom,qcm2290-venus, linux-firmware venus.mbn 6.0-00055, gst-plugins-good rebuilt with v4l2-probe, avenc_aac ranked primary; encoder and decoder probed on 7.3.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Sensors (accelerometer, gyroscope, magnetometer, light, proximity)
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not yet: userspace built and packaged, never run against the ADSP.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: SSC service 400 announced by the ADSP; hexagonrpc (PR 27 fork), libssc 0.4.4, protobuf-c and sensorfw-qt5-ssc 0.1-1 built; qx1050-hexagonrpcd.service disabled pending a supervised first run.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Battery and charging
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: works: level and charging state read correctly; board-specific driver, not an upstream route.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: PMI632 via pro1x-adc-battery and pro1x-icl.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: port log 2026-10-26 20:40; Pro1-X port repo port/kernel/HANDOVER.md

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: USB
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: built-in CDC gadget gives network (172.16.42.1) and serial for development; usb-moded (MTP, charging/mode menu) cannot run beside it.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: policies-setup.service fails at every boot because usb-moded is not on D-Bus; Type-C charging works.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: microSD
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not yet: no card detected.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: sdhci_msm has its card-detect GPIO but reports no card on 7.1; no later evidence.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Torch
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not started: no torch toggle appears; no work done.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Observed on SailfishOS on 7.1.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Lock code and home encryption
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not yet: setting a lock code fails because the directory rootfs has no encrypted home volume.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: sailfish-device-encryption-community exists on the dontbeevil OBS; not set up.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: RTC
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: partial: the clock starts at 1970 until NTP sets it.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Observed on the NixOS 7.1 kernel; not rechecked on 7.3.

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not started: no positioning work recorded.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: No evidence about the GNSS path (modem location service, gpsd or geoclue provider) in any port note as of 2026-10-27; native-common ships geoclue-provider-gpsd3.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.source: absence of evidence in the port notes; native-common file listing 2026-10-23

fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.title: Suspend, battery drain and long-uptime reliability
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.general: not started: not measured.
fxtec_pro1x_qx1050.instance: Longest recorded uptime with a full hardware check: 3 h 44 min on 7.3 (2026-10-26).

related_devices.title: F(x)tec Pro1 (qx1000, MSM8998): mainline status
related_devices.general: not started (for a mainline SailfishOS port): upstream has the board DTS without display, panel, GPU or keyboard; those exist only in a stale fork.
related_devices.instance: Upstream msm8998-fxtec-pro1.dts since v5.16 (AngeloGioacchino Del Regno, 2021), no audio codec nodes in msm8998.dtsi. gitlab.com/msm8998-mainline/linux (last commit 2023-02-05, 6.1) adds panel boe,bf060y8m-aj0 (driver upstream since v5.17), a GPU node with a voltage hack, the keyboard via AW9523 plus an out-of-tree gpio-fastmatrix-keyboard (pinctrl-aw9523 upstream since v6.9), haptics. pmaports MR !2984 (2022) closed unmerged; the postmarketOS msm8998 kernel package is stuck at 6.0. Mesa freedreno a5xx gives GLES 3.1. Display, GPU, keyboard and audio would need upstreaming first.

related_devices.title: F(x)tec Pro1-X hybris port (contrast and baseline)
related_devices.general: works as a hybris port: the same phone on the vendor 4.19 kernel with Halium, used as the performance baseline and as a source of adaptation values.
related_devices.instance: piggz's halium-qx1050 (sailfish-on-fxtecpro1), newest image SFOS 5.0.0.62 (2025-04-09), upgradable to 5.1 through OBS nemo:testing:hw:fxtec:halium-qx1050:5.1; Halium 4.19 rework pushed 2026-10-03/04. Needs the stock F(x)tec v2.1.2 base on the phone; DNS on 5.1 needs systemd-resolve in group inet (PARANOID_NETWORK).
